why: HELIOD TO BRACKET 3 (the pilot, 2026-11-12): v1.4.0 read B4 only for eight Game Changers; keep Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe, Mystical Tutor. A group-hug deck with a light pillow fort and kills that overlap, so drawing into one draws into the next. As of 2026-11-13 the branch is twenty-eight out, twenty-eight in against the sleeved v1.4.0. THE CORE METRIC is Heliod's generic discount: cards opponents draw this turn. Every-player X draws (Prosperity, Fascination, Folio of Fancies, Vision Skeins) beat targeted ones; Mathemagics is exponential; Forced Fruition makes every opponent spell a seven-card draw. KILLS: Approach of the Second Sun (Mystical Tutor, Personal Tutor, Solve the Equation, Long-Term Plans, Dig Through Time on the top seven, Top, Scroll Rack; Mystic Sanctuary rebuys a countered copy; Teferi, Silence, Pact of Negation protect the win; stack 007); the Crawlers (Scrawling: each opponent draw costs a life; Psychosis: each of your draws costs every opponent a life) with Teferi's Ageless Insight and Bard, King of Dale doubling your draws; two three-card infinites on Smothering Tithe (Bard + Gleaming Splendor; Faerie Mastermind + Mirrormade); Walking Ballista as the mana sink. FORT: Ghostly Prison, Propaganda, Sphere of Safety, The Second Doctor. ANSWERS: Supreme Verdict, Austere Command, Winds of Abandon, Soul-Guide Lantern. MANA: thirty-five lands, blue-weighted (Sea of Clouds, Floodfarm Verge, Islands for Plains and Reliquary Tower). Pilot's rules: no mill or Laboratory Maniac win line; Dig Through Time and Walking Ballista stay; no two-card infinites (Isochron Scepter + Dramatic Reversal stays out).
